mukta-m0-p73-v1801.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1801.question: What devotional acts must be performed with effort toward the deity?
premises: The deity is to be worshipped
Worship must be done with effort
The deity is to be praised with various hymns
mukta-m0-p73-v1801.inference: Devotees must worship and praise the deity diligently with diverse hymns.

mukta-m0-p73-v1802.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1802.question: What sin is removed by bathing in that sacred place?
premises: A person bathes in that place
The address is to the fair one
Bathing there removes brahman-murder
mukta-m0-p73-v1802.inference: Bathing in that place removes the sin of brahman-murder.

mukta-m0-p73-v1803.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1803.question: What sacred site named Kapilā lies north of that place?
premises: A location is north of that place
It is five bows away
The site is named Kapilā
mukta-m0-p73-v1803.inference: Five bows to the north of that place lies the site named Kapilā.

mukta-m0-p73-v1804.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1804.question: What mental state is required when bathing at Kapilāhnadatīrtha?
premises: The place is Kapilāhnadatīrtha
One bathes there
The bather must have a restrained mind
mukta-m0-p73-v1804.inference: Bathing at Kapilāhnadatīrtha requires a restrained mind.

mukta-m0-p73-v1805.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1805.question: In which direction must one face to ascend Bhasmakūṭaka?
premises: One should ascend Bhasmakūṭaka
The ascent must be done facing east
The direction is emphasized
mukta-m0-p73-v1805.inference: One must ascend Bhasmakūṭaka while facing east.

mukta-m0-p73-v1806.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1806.question: What declaration and salutation accompany the ascent of Bhasmakūṭa?
premises: The speaker declares ascent of the peak
The peak is Bhasmakūṭa
Obeisance is offered to it
mukta-m0-p73-v1806.inference: The ascent is accompanied by declaring the climb and offering obeisance.

mukta-m0-p73-v1807.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1807.question: What happens to merit accumulated over ten births upon this ascent?
premises: Merit was accumulated over ten births
The consequence occurs at that very moment
That merit perishes
mukta-m0-p73-v1807.inference: Merit accumulated over ten births perishes immediately upon this ascent.

mukta-m0-p73-v1808.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p73-v1808.question: What worldly possessions are lost immediately upon this ascent?
premises: Wealth, son, and wife are mentioned
All these are included
They perish at that very moment
mukta-m0-p73-v1808.inference: Wealth, son, wife, and all possessions perish immediately upon this ascent.

mukta-m0-p73-v1809.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

premises: The goddess is addressed to listen
The subject is greatness
The greatness belongs to the bull-bannered one

mukta-m0-p73-v1810.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

One worships the god
The worship is done with effort

mukta-m0-p73-v1811.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
